name: Regroup
text: Discard your hand and draw 5 new cards.

name: Ice the Shooter
text: Their attempt this possession is at -10%.

name: Intentional Foul
text: They shoot two free throws (70% each, 1 point each) instead of running their play.

name: Hold for the Last Shot
text: +15% on your shot this turn, but the turn ends the moment you shoot.

name: Two-for-One
text: You may shoot twice this turn. Both shots are at -12%.
